top_signals.title: Mota-Engil Said to Win Deal for US-Backed Congo Copper Rail
top_signals.summary: Mota-Engil SGPS SA is set to sign a 30-year concession with the Democratic Republic of Congo to operate a key copper and cobalt railway, potentially backed with up to $1 billion of US financing.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Bond rout ending? Massive bets on bond rally dominate options market
top_signals.summary: There's an old Wall Street adage: Stocks float on a sea of bonds. Options traders are betting the tide is going out.

top_signals.title: Sanctioned ICC chief urges Japan to counter U.S. campaign
top_signals.summary: "I can state categorically that there is absolutely no reason for me to be sanctioned," the Japanese ICC chief said.
